description: This file contains unit tests for web server and client interactions within the WPEFramework, utilizing Google Test framework. It defines WebServer and WebClient classes that simulate web request/response handling, and a test case that verifies web link functionality.

classes.name: WebServer
classes.description: A mock web server class that handles incoming web requests, verifies request details, and sends responses.

classes.name: WebClient
classes.description: A mock web client class that sends web requests, receives responses, and verifies response details.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a text body to the request or response.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Handles incoming request or response, performs verification, and processes data.

methods.name: Retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves received data from the web response.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for data to be received.
